# SelNexa Health

> SelNexa Health (Private) Limited is a software company in Harare, Zimbabwe, building offline first systems for health institutions. Its flagship product, the SelNexa Health Platform, runs registration, records, procurement, billing and reporting, keeps working without a connection and syncs when the connection returns. The company also sells a data protection compliance service under Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act and SI 155 of 2024.

## Stage

- Pre-deployment: no health institution is live on the Platform yet.
- First pilot in preparation. We will name the site once approvals are in place.
- Figures for the Platform's indicators will be published once the first pilot has been independently evaluated.

## Products

- SelNexa Health Platform: health service management for health institutions, with modules for administration, predictive procurement, health records, real-time analytics and a telemedicine beta. Records use FHIR R4. Designed to sit alongside national systems and exchange data with them through FHIR R4 (DHIS2, Impilo, ePMS, OpenMRS).
- Patient data stays in Zimbabwe, and can stay in the building. The LAN kit runs the full system inside a health institution with no internet line.
- SelNexa data protection service: gets health institutions licensed under SI 155 of 2024 with a certified data protection officer and working procedures. Readiness check, full compliance, and a retained data protection officer.

## Security

- TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, role-based access, tamper-evident audit trails and consent-aware access.
- Built to Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act and SI 155 of 2024. Breaches are reported to POTRAZ within 24 hours.
- ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2: control mapping in progress. The company holds no security certification.
